reply_text:
I found no dated AI predictions by Ilya Sutskever from 2024. He spoke in public a handful of times that year, and he avoided giving timelines. In his December NeurIPS talk he said of superintelligent systems, "I'm not saying how or when, just that it will happen."

**What I found:**
- **The Safe Superintelligence announcement (19 June 2024).** It opens with "Superintelligence is within reach." That is undated and about when superintelligence arrives, so I've listed it under undated. I read it in a copy of the full text posted on LessWrong (it links to ssi.inc), not on ssi.inc itself. The announcement is signed by all three co-founders, not by Sutskever alone.
- **The NeurIPS Test of Time talk (13 December 2024).** I read a fan-made transcript on kingy.ai, which embeds the video; it is not an official transcript. He says pre-training "will unquestionably end" and that superintelligence is "obviously where this field is headed." Neither line names a date or a span, so neither counts.
- **Reuters (November 2024).** I read this in a reprint on insidetelecom.com. His quotes look back ("The 2010s were the age of scaling…") and say what matters now. Nothing is dated.
- **The Bloomberg interview (19 June 2024).** It is behind a paywall. The visible part has one quote saying SSI's first product will be safe superintelligence, with no date. The paywalled rest could hold more.
- **The Reuters interview (September 2024).** The Yahoo Finance page loaded only the site menu, so I have nothing to quote from it.

**Other years:** the later coverage that came up deals with his November 2025 interview with Dwarkesh Patel. One headline claims AGI "in just 5 years". I did not open those pages and did not check the claim.

I used 8 of 12 searches and 5 of 6 page openings. In my code the first fixed search hit an error while I was printing the results. The search itself had run and its results were kept, so I did not run it again.
